rationale: Raw source shows that the extracted schedule values are faithful: the March 31, 2026 schedule explicitly reports total investment fair value of 1,597,977 and 166.3% of net assets, while the balance sheet reports total net assets of 962,397. Recomputing from those independently disclosed totals gives 166.04%, approximately 166.0% at the filing's one-decimal presentation, not 166.3%. The flag therefore reflects a filing-level identity mismatch or unsuitable exact recomputation anchor, not a platform data error. Position-level percentages are also presented only to one decimal, so strict per-row algebra is sensitive to source rounding.
